markdown.markdown:
The navbar is the top navigation part of the website.

[Quarto page on Website Navigation](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-navigation.html)

## Main options

Template:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
  navbar:
    #Title on top left of navbar
    title: Title
    #Image left of title
    logo: "images/logo.png"
    # When to collapse to hamburger menu
    # lg is default
    collapse-below: lg
```


::: {.callout-note}
Mind the indentation which is required.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
The size of the logo is set in the [css](/css/css.qmd) as `.navbar-logo`
:::

## Navbar left

This sub-segment determines the links of the parts to be displayed right of the title (left of navbar).

This site's Navbar left:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
###Navbar left
    left:
      - text: "Overview"
        href: index.qmd
      - text: "Setup"
        href: setup/setup.qmd
      - text: "qmd"
        href: qmds/qmds.qmd
      - text: "css"
        href: css/css.qmd
      - text: "yml"
        href: yml/yml.qmd
```

## Navbar right

This sub-segment determines the various author's links (e.g. bluesky and linkedin to include).
By default a toggle for dark/light mode 
(`r icons::icon_style(icons::fontawesome("toggle-on", style="solid"), fill = "#648fff")`) 
and a search button
(`r icons::icon_style(icons::fontawesome("search", style="solid"), fill = "#648fff")`)
are included.

My personal links:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
###Navbar right
    right:
    # List of icons: https://icons.getbootstrap.com/
      - icon: cup
        href: https://ko-fi.com/waveofinspiration
        aria-label: Ko-fi
      - icon: bluesky
        href: https://bsky.app/profile/m-gemmell.bsky.social
        aria-label: BlueSky
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/m-gemmell/Quarto_guide
        aria-label: GitHub
```

NEOF links:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
###Navbar right
    right:
    - icon: house-fill
      href: https://neof.org.uk/training/
      aria-label: NEOF website
    - icon: linkedin
      href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/training-neof/
      aria-label: LinkedIn
    - icon: bluesky
      href: https://bsky.app/profile/nerc-eof.bsky.social
      aria-label: bluesky
```

CGR links:

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
###Navbar right
    right:
    - icon: house-fill
      href: https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/genomic-research/
      aria-label: CGR website
    - icon: linkedin
      href: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/liverpool-shared-research-facilities
      aria-label: LinkedIn
```
